requirements.title: Policy inspection is complete, deterministic and non-mutating

source.excerpt:
A pure resolver computes exact definitions, obligation membership, applicability
conditions, boundaries, references, conflicts and a deterministic definition
identity. It executes no project command or network call and grants no consent.

requirements.rationale: A proposed engineering definition cannot silently drop controls, alter old policy meanings or be mistaken for qualification or migration.

criteria.expected: Exact supported definitions account for every historical rule, retain mandatory controls and stable meanings, reject invalid definitions and preview the actual project difference without writes or command execution.

requirements.title: Explicit policy boundaries require current meaningful verification

source.excerpt:
Policy-2 replacement controls consume the ordinary current change review, not
project-level generic passing assertions.

requirements.rationale: Policy identity, capability applicability and current evidence cannot be silently downgraded or confused with selection, other stages or external-standard conformance.

criteria.expected: Schema-4 policy-2 evaluation preserves old selections, enforces capability/current source-stage control links, keeps known failures and external verdicts distinct, and does not qualify recovery without actual appropriate execution.

requirements.title: Additional standards are exact, additive and honest about scope

source.excerpt: `assess` is independent and adds no gate check. `require` contributes a blocking

requirements.rationale: A selected external mapping must neither waive the baseline nor repeat verification, conceal incomplete conformance or qualify another boundary.

criteria.expected: Exact validated selections distinguish no-verdict guidance, nonblocking assessment and stage-scoped required obligations using one current execution; partial mappings, changed definitions, known failures and forged reports cannot become full conformance.

members.assertion: Complete historical accounting with unchanged retained definitions and exact external rules; distinct repeatable version identities.
members.discriminating_case: A missing historical rule, changed retained statement or preview that changes selected policy fails. Catalog 4 is now supported only through explicit schema-4 selection.

members.assertion: Unknown versions and IDs, missing replacements, duplicate definitions and orphan additions are rejected.
members.discriminating_case: Adding an unmapped or duplicate replacement must not resolve a smaller baseline.

members.assertion: Mandatory build/style/security/testing obligations remain and changed semantics change identity.
members.discriminating_case: Removing TEST-002 or keeping a digest after a changed normative statement fails.

members.assertion: Real CLI explains a replacement outside a repository, rejects unsupported requests and creates no files.
members.discriminating_case: An --apply flag or unknown rule cannot succeed; an empty directory remains empty.

members.assertion: Real initialized-project preview identifies legacy additions/removals and leaves contract/config/files unchanged.
members.discriminating_case: Any execution of the declared git config mutation, contract rewrite, or omitted baseline addition fails.

review.rationale: Reviewed all five assertions against this criterion: historical accounting and unchanged retained statements, invalid-definition failures, mandatory control retention/digest sensitivity, outside-project errors/nonmutation and real project diff/nonexecution. Complete input definitions and command dispatch are bound. Suite assurance, not named-case execution, conformance or approval; current execution remains required. Reviewed corrected historical-role wording and the direct human-output regression; historical presence is not automatic external-standard membership. Reviewed Policy2 changes: original assertions and legacy semantics retained; explicit catalog4 support does not activate policy during preview. Updated changed source/input bindings; schema and acceptance paths remain under tests. The superseded catalog4 rejection expectation is replaced by explicit schema/version tests. Reviewed Policy2 standards integration: original tests and legacy paths retain their assertions. Optional omitted fields preserve serialization; pure selection happens before execution, required projections remain additive, and standard modes do not change baseline membership. New tests cover command-count reuse, conflicting selection, bounded stage effects, incomplete mapping and report tampering. Refresh reflects reviewed changed schema/dispatch/aggregation inputs, not a qualification or consent claim.

members.assertion: A real recovery suite must run at its selected boundary with current control mapping; safe restore is not MinimumCD rollback.
members.discriminating_case: Evaluation-only, another stage, or deleted control links stay unverified even with green other checks.

members.assertion: Exact pins and unambiguous mode/stage selection are required.
members.discriminating_case: Floating/unknown versions, invalid levels, baseline-as-external, empty or duplicate stages cannot resolve.

members.assertion: Equivalent stage ordering preserves identity; changed mode or membership changes it.
members.discriminating_case: Reordering stages must not invalidate identity; changing assess to require must invalidate it.

members.assertion: All bundled derived/format profiles retain incomplete-conformance status.
members.discriminating_case: A derived SSDF/OSPS or SLSA/CycloneDX format selection cannot claim a complete assessment mapping.

members.assertion: Guidance has no verdict; assessment does not block; required failed rollback blocks only selected delivery, with idempotent schema-valid projection.
members.discriminating_case: A failed MinimumCD rollback may not block integration or disappear from its independent assessment.

members.assertion: Complete current mapping can pass; missing required evidence blocks selected boundary; outside boundary no assessment; baseline failure still blocks.
members.discriminating_case: A delivery selection cannot claim pre-merge assessment or clear an OPDEV-FLOW failure.

members.assertion: Partial/format mappings remain unverified even with green contributing rules; changed definition is rejected.
members.discriminating_case: Synthetic all-green rule findings cannot turn a partial SSDF or provenance mapping into conformance.

members.assertion: Known failed/error/migration/unverified commands remain visible including colliding result names.
members.discriminating_case: Projection cannot delete a suite whose ID matches a generated standard ID; unique gate blockers do not drop underlying results.

members.assertion: Current immutable mapping restores source/scope metadata and rejects duplicate/conflicting selections.
members.discriminating_case: Forged certification, duplicate standards or legacy/new MinimumCD conflict cannot survive resolution.

members.assertion: Real CLI preview is read-only; three selected standards share exactly one current canonical invocation; no-exec stays missing.
members.discriminating_case: Counter remains absent after preview, equals one after real check, and cannot increase during no-exec.

members.assertion: Invalid or conflicting selection and an unselected current MinimumCD assessment fail before command side effects.
members.discriminating_case: Invalid schema, duplicate/legacy conflict, unknown version/mode/empty stages, guidance-only and another stage cannot launch the counter.

members.assertion: Saved report validation recomputes standard results and metadata, not only gate blockers.
members.discriminating_case: Changing failure to error with the same blocker ID or changing the source claim to certified makes the saved view invalid.

members.assertion: Partial, gap and empty rule mappings stay unverified.
members.discriminating_case: An empty mapping cannot pass by vacuous all-green aggregation.

review.rationale: Reviewed all twelve required targets and actual assertions: exact pure identity, stages, complete-mapping limits, independent/additive verdicts, baseline preservation, original failure outcomes, saved-report integrity and real CLI count/nonexecution. Current stage canonical suite execution remains required. Synthetic tests verify plumbing and claim boundaries, not organizational conformance, test adequacy for every product, live-agent effectiveness or developer consent. Bound known inputs are not an automatically exhaustive dependency graph.
